[[File:Edmund.png|250px|thumb|Edmund]] '''Edmund''' (Japanese: '''エドモンド''' ''Edmund'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW070|The Clubsplosion Begins!]]''. He was [[Stephan]]'s first opponent in the [[Clubsplosion]] tournament. Edmund has earned the nickname "Rain Man", to account for the fact that every time he battles, a rainstorm suddenly appears over him. His battle with Stephan was no exception, and he was confident that he would be victorious because of his {{p|Seismitoad}}'s [[Ability]], {{a|Swift Swim}}. However, he did not count on Seismitoad getting injured and thus slowing down, which led to his loss. Edmund usually appears to be quite meek and timid, but he is uncharacteristically more aggressive in battle. He is a strategic and adaptable {{pkmn|Trainer}}, often having Seismitoad use a combination of its speed and {{m|Mud Shot}} to keep its opponent distant. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Edmund |pkmn=Seismitoad |img=Edmund Seismitoad.png |type1=Water |type2=Ground |epnum=BW070 |epname=The Clubsplosion Begins! |vajp=Kensuke Satō |vaen=Carter Cathcart |desc={{p|Seismitoad}} is Edmund's only known Pokémon. It was shown to be capable of handling itself in close-combat situations. It was used in the first round of the [[Clubsplosion]] against [[Stephan's Sawk]]. Its Ability Swift Swim helped it gain speed in the battle, but it wasn't enough. Its leg was injured by {{p|Sawk}}'s {{m|Low Sweep}}, which slowed it down, and it lost the battle after being hit by Sawk's {{m|Close Combat}}. Seismitoad's known moves are {{m|Drain Punch}}, {{m|Mud Shot}}, and {{m|Brick Break}}, and its Ability is {{a|Swift Swim}}.}} ==Pokémon competitions== Edmund has competed in the following {{cat|Pokémon competitions}}: * [[Clubsplosion]] - Top 16 (''[[BW070|The Clubsplosion Begins!]]'') ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{water color}}|bordercolor={{ground color light}} |ja=古島清孝 ''[[Kiyotaka Furushima]]'' |en=[[Tom Wayland]] |es_eu=Javier Lorca |fi=Aku Laitinen |fr_eu=Alexandre Crépet |no=Eirik Espolin Johnson |pl=Otar Saralidze}}
